codeReview.summary: All 17 required shadcn/ui components are installed in src/components/ui/ with correct TypeScript types. The cn() utility is properly implemented using clsx + tailwind-merge. Toaster (Sonner) and TooltipProvider are correctly wired into App.tsx. The worker made a sound adaptation by replacing next-themes dependency in sonner.tsx with a local useSyncExternalStore hook that reads the data-theme attribute from the DOM, which aligns with how the ThemeProvider applies theme state. The ComponentsShowcase page provides comprehensive visual verification of all components. TypeScript compiles cleanly with zero errors.

issues.description: "use client" directive is a Next.js artifact that has no effect in Vite. Present in 6 component files (form.tsx, dropdown-menu.tsx, select.tsx, collapsible.tsx, tabs.tsx, separator.tsx). Harmless but could be cleaned up for clarity. This is standard shadcn/ui generated output.
Same "use client" directive issue applies to dropdown-menu.tsx, select.tsx, collapsible.tsx, tabs.tsx, and separator.tsx.

sharedStateObservations.observation: shadcn/ui components are generated with "use client" directives by default (Next.js convention). In this Vite-based project, these are no-ops. The worker left them as-is, which is reasonable since they're standard shadcn output and don't cause issues. AGENTS.md could document whether these should be stripped.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly identified that the default shadcn sonner.tsx uses next-themes and adapted it to use a local useSyncExternalStore hook reading data-theme attribute. This is a good pattern for non-Next.js projects using shadcn/ui and should be documented as a project convention.
